title: Surgical Integrity & Substrate Verification
description: Rules for ensuring the reliability and authenticity of logic and memory artifacts.

barber_shave_paradox.name: The Barber Paradox
barber_shave_paradox.rule: A file cannot self-verify via an internal checksum (writing the checksum invalidates the file). Integrity must be verified against the external Salted Release history in Git.

surgical_deletion.name: Surgical Deletion Mandate
surgical_deletion.rule: NEVER use 'rm -rf' or 'rm -fr' for directory removal. Follow the surgical sequence: 1. 'mv' contents to 'repos/diy-make/memory/trash/', 2. Use 'rmdir' to remove the empty directory. 'rmdir' acts as a final safety check.
surgical_deletion.rationale: Prevents accidental mass-deletion of critical architectural nodes and ensures the agent has perfect visibility into every byte removed from the Heartwood.

substrate_primacy.name: Substrate Primacy
substrate_primacy.rule: The integrity of the machine-logic layer (json/py) is the highest priority. If an md/ reflection drifts from its json/ source, the json/ source is the authoritative record.
substrate_primacy.rationale: Eliminates ambiguity by defining a clear hierarchy of truth within the metarepo.
